mapper.sql: id, case_id, trigger_type, trigger_key, orchestrator_runs_status, next_action, CAST(result_data AS text) AS result_data, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orchestrator_runs (case_id, trigger_type, trigger_key) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerKey}) ON CONFLICT (case_id, trigger_type, trigger_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE orchestrator_runs SET orchestrator_runs_status = 'PROCESSING', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND orchestrator_runs_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE orchestrator_runs SET result_data = CAST(#{resultData,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND orchestrator_runs_status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE orchestrator_runs SET orchestrator_runs_status = 'COMPLETED', next_action = #{nextAction,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, result_data = CAST(#{resultData,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), updated_at = now(), completed_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND orchestrator_runs_status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE orchestrator_runs SET orchestrator_runs_status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now(), completed_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND orchestrator_runs_status = 'PROCESSING'
